case_study.context: Inherited a stagnant Instagram account. Rebuilt strategy from scratch: audience definition, visual identity, tone, content pillars and competitor benchmarking.
case_study.what_i_do: Run the full pipeline solo: concept, scripting, camera, direction, editing (DaVinci Resolve), subtitles, sound design, copy, scheduling and community management.
case_study.attribution_note: In the same months content went live, daily sales grew from ~30 to 100–150 burgers. Customers regularly cite Instagram when asked how they found the place.

reels.title: The burger smash challenge
reels.highlight: Trend hijacking: matched a viral audio format to native content, reaching a mass audience far outside the existing fanbase in a single post.

reels.title: 1,000 Argentina chip bags
reels.highlight: Turning disaster into reach: 1,000 World Cup bags arrived a day late. Reframed the loss into self-deprecating comedy with a quick 1-second capture.

reels.title: Macro burger craft
reels.highlight: High production on a budget: replicated a premium commercial look using low-cost lighting and tight macro angles. Craft over gear.

reels.title: Early-stage scarcity
reels.highlight: Authentic storytelling: captured a raw kitchen moment running low on prep. Framed real capacity limits as high demand, sparking the growth snowball.
